string-array.name: help_bodies
string-array.item:
• On first start, choose TV (TV box with a remote) or Mobile (phone or tablet with touch).
• WorldTV starts with Free TV: about 2,000 free-to-air channels from around the world (a public list, github.com/Free-TV/IPTV; live TV only). It loads on first start; a "Please wait" screen shows until it is ready.
• Add your own playlist (section 3); everything else comes from your IPTV provider. You can delete Free TV (Settings > Playlists); it isn't added again.
• As admin: Settings > Categories (show / hide), enter the PIN (000000 unless you changed it) and check which categories are shown. Adult content is already hidden (sections 17 and 18).
• Change the PIN to your own (section 15), so others can't undo your choices.

• TV: big tiles and lists for the remote. Up / Down / Left / Right move, OK selects, Back goes back, Menu opens extra options.\n• Mobile: portrait screens for touch. Tap selects, long-press works like Menu. Full screen video turns the phone to landscape.\n• Change it any time: Settings > Layout.

• Settings > Add playlist (or Settings > Playlists > Add playlist).
• Xtream Codes: enter the server address (e.g. http://example.com:8080), username and password from your provider.
• M3U URL: paste the playlist link. If it is an Xtream link (get.php?username=…), WorldTV signs in with Xtream automatically, which is faster.
• PIN: leave empty to use 000000, or enter your own 6 digits.
• Save and load downloads all channels, movies and series. Big playlists take a while (up to several minutes on a slow box); the screen stays on until the home screen appears.
• Adult content is hidden from this first load on.

• Live TV, Movies and Series open the libraries of the active playlist.
• TV: behind the tiles, a slider shows 5 recent movies, then 3 recent series, that are in your playlist, with large pictures. They change every 8 seconds. Press Up to reach More info: Left / Right change the title, OK opens its page (play from there). Titles and pictures come from TMDB and are picked once a day (after the 3 am reload): only movies rated PG-13 or lower and series rated TV-14 / M or lower, no horror, and every picture is first checked on the box by an image filter that leaves out anything revealing. If one still isn't right: Menu on More info > Hide from the home screen (needs the playlist PIN).
• App Settings > Backdrop region: show only titles in the languages you tick (English, Indian languages, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Korean, Japanese; several at once). Each is judged by its own country's family ratings. None ticked: every language.
• Top right: when the account is valid till (e.g. Valid Till: 07-Mar-2027), ⟳ Reload playlist and ⋮ Menu (App Settings, All apps, System settings; TV: Add app to home screen).
• Reload playlist downloads everything again (new channels, removed ones, new adult content to hide). Favourites, your groups, Continue watching, sorting and your show/hide choices are kept. It also happens by itself (section 20).
• TV layout: your own apps can sit in a row under the big tiles: ⋮ Menu > Add app to home screen. Long-press or Menu on one to change or remove it. None by default.
• The slider uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

• Live TV, Movies and Series have a small bar at the top: Home · Live TV · Movies · Series. The one you are in is filled.\n• Press Up from the search box to reach it, then OK on another one to jump straight there (no need to go back to the home screen).

• Categories on the left, channels in the middle, a preview on the right (on Mobile: preview on top, categories in a sideways strip).
• OK (tap) on a channel plays it in the preview; OK again goes full screen.
• Full screen: Up / Down or CH+ / CH- change channel, OK shows the controls, Back steps back.
• Menu (long-press) on a channel: Favourites and your groups (section 10).
• Live TV opens on Favourites when you have any; otherwise on the last category you used, on the last channel you watched.
• 0 (or a Last / Recall key on the remote, or the ⇄ button in full screen) goes back to the channel you watched before, and pressing it again returns. Handy for flipping between two channels.
• Now and next: when your provider has a TV guide for the channel, what is on now (with a bar showing how far in it is) and what is on next show under the preview and in the full-screen banner. Not every provider or channel has one; then nothing is shown.
• Catch-up: on channels where your provider keeps recordings, ⟲ Catch-up shows under the preview, in the Menu (long-press) and as a button in full screen. It lists the earlier programmes you can watch again (newest first); one plays like a movie, with pause and seeking. Back returns to live TV. Channels without recordings don't show it.
• Settings > Live channel order puts the channels in your own order (section 19).
• In categories you choose for Channel check (section 27), a green dot ● marks channels that work, and channels that didn't work are dimmed. A dimmed channel can still be played: OK tries it.

• Categories on the left, posters on the right. OK opens a title.
• Movies: Play (or Resume / From start if you watched part of it). Series: choose a season, then an episode.
• Menu (long-press) on a poster adds or removes a favourite.
• Sort (top right): Newest (default: latest added first) → Rating (highest first) → A–Z → Z–A → Provider order. Remembered for Movies and Series separately. Favourites and Continue watching keep their own order.

• Every poster with a rating shows it top left (★ 7.3, out of 10). Ratings come from your provider; when a title's page finds a rating the list didn't have, the poster keeps it from then on. Titles the provider gives no rating show no badge.
• Sort by Rating puts the best first.
• A title's page shows its rating, year, length, genre, director and the date it was added (e.g. Added: 09-Oct-2026).
• Trailer: plays the trailer in the YouTube app. If the provider has no trailer link, YouTube opens a search for the title's trailer.
• Cast: a row of photos with names. Photos come from TMDB when you have added a TMDB key (Settings > Online accounts), otherwise from Wikipedia (nothing to set up). A name with no photo shows its initials. TV series show the cast under the poster.
• Actor's titles: OK (or tap) on a cast photo lists that actor's movies and series on this playlist, movies first, newest first; OK on a poster opens it. With a TMDB key the whole filmography is looked up and matched to the playlist by title and year. Without one, only titles whose cast the provider lists (most series; movies once their page has been opened).

• The Search box is at the top of every category list.
• It finds channel and title names, and also categories: searching "cricket" shows a "Search: cricket" row (matching channels) and every category with cricket in its name.
• Pick any of them to browse it. Clear the box to get the full category list back.
• On TV, the keyboard's Search key jumps to the results (or to the first matching category).

• Favourites is a category at the top of each library: add with Menu (long-press) on a channel or poster, or with the ★ button in the Live TV player.
• Continue watching (Movies and Series) lists what you stopped part-way, newest first. Adult titles are never listed.
• Most watched (Live TV, just under ＋ Add group): the channels you really watch. A channel joins after you watch it for 5 minutes or more on 3 occasions in 30 days; only time with the picture playing counts, and a stretch of more than 4 hours (a box left on) doesn't count. Going back to a channel within 15 minutes carries on the same viewing. The more often and the more lately you watch a channel, the higher it is; channels you stop watching slowly drop off. Up to 25 channels; adult and hidden channels are never listed. Menu (long-press) on a channel there: Remove from Most watched.
• Your own groups (Live TV): ＋ Add group at the top of the category list makes one; new groups appear at the top, above All and Favourites.
• Menu (long-press) on a channel, or the ★ button in the player: add it to, or remove it from, Favourites or any of your groups, or make a new group with it (＋ New group…).
• Menu (long-press) on one of your groups: rename or delete it (its channels stay in the playlist).
• Favourites and groups are kept on reloads and when you Clear history.

• OK (tap) shows the controls; they hide by themselves after a few seconds.
• The focused button's name appears above it (on touch: long-press a button).
• Buttons: audio track, subtitles, previous / next (channel or episode), back 10 s, play / pause, forward 30 s, picture (Fit → Stretch → Zoom), and Open in… (another player, for streams WorldTV can't play).
• Movies and episodes: Left / Right seek when the controls are hidden; on touch, drag the bar.
• Mobile: the arrow top left leaves full screen.

• Where they come from: subtitles built into the video file (most MKV files have some; many MP4 files have none), and, for movies and episodes, OpenSubtitles.com when you set it up.
• In the player: the subtitles button lists the built-in ones, Off, and Search online…
• Search online… looks the title up on OpenSubtitles (by the provider's TMDB / IMDb number when it has one, else by name and year; episodes by season and episode), in your subtitle language, then English. Pick a result and it appears within a few seconds, at the same place in the movie.
• Setting it up (once, free): make an account at opensubtitles.com, open Profile > API consumers > New consumer, then add its API key in Settings > Online accounts > OpenSubtitles (section 22). Your OpenSubtitles username and password are optional and allow more downloads per day. Several accounts can be added; when one runs out, the next is used.
• Settings > Subtitle settings: Show subtitles automatically (On: subtitles in your language show by themselves), Language, Size (Small to Huge), Colour (White, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Pink) and Background (Outline only, Black box, See-through box).

• App Settings (home screen, ⋮ Menu top right) is a screen of tiles: Playlists, Add playlist, Playlist Auto Reload, Channel check, Subtitle settings, Categories (show / hide), Categories order, Live channel order, Online accounts, DNS, Auto-start on boot, Home screen, Home app slots, Theme, Layout, Check for updates on start, Update now, Help, Clear history and Reset app. All apps and System settings are in the same ⋮ Menu.\n• Theme: Classic (maroon), Glass (see-through panels on deep blue) or Showtime (colourful indigo and orange). The screens change at once.\n• Tiles that switch something show what is set now (e.g. "Playlist Auto Reload: Every day at 3 am"); OK changes it or opens a short list of choices.

• Settings > Playlists lists your playlists; the active one is marked. OK (tap) opens a playlist.
• Long-press or Menu on a playlist: Open, Refresh, Details, Categories (show / hide), Delete.
• Details (server, username, password, PIN), Categories and Delete need the playlist's PIN.
• Add as many playlists as you like and switch between them here.

• Every playlist has a 6-digit PIN. It starts as 000000.
• Change it: Settings > Playlists, long-press the playlist > Details > enter the PIN > Change PIN. "Reset to 000000" puts the default back.
• The PIN protects the login details, the show/hide choices, the adult words, deleting the playlist and Reset app. It does not lock watching.
• After 5 wrong PINs, entry is blocked for 30 seconds.
• Note: adding a playlist again from Add playlist is not PIN-protected.

• Settings > Categories (show / hide) > PIN (for the active playlist; others: Settings > Playlists, long-press the playlist > Categories).
• Tabs: Live TV (show/hide), Movies (show/hide), Series (show/hide). ✓ = shown, ✕ = hidden.
• OK (tap) on a category shows or hides the whole category.
• Menu (long-press) on a category opens its channels / titles: OK shows or hides each one. A category with some hidden inside shows "(N hidden)".
• Show all goes back to the defaults: everything is shown except adult content, which stays hidden; to show an adult category or channel, select it one by one.
• Hidden means gone everywhere: the category list, All, Favourites, Continue watching, search and changing channel.
• Your choices are kept on every reload and refresh. Showing a category shows all of it.

• WorldTV hides adult content automatically, every time a playlist loads, reloads or refreshes (new adult channels included).
• It hides: categories whose names contain category words (XXX, Adult, 18+, Porn…), channels and titles with channel words (studio names, explicit terms…), and anything the provider itself marks as adult.
• Words also used in normal titles (sex, porn, fuck, milf…) only hide a channel when two different ones appear together, so films like "Sex Education" or "xXx" stay.
• It goes by name only: anything with an innocent name is not caught. Check the category list yourself.
• What you show or hide by hand always wins, after every reload.
• Hide adult (Categories screen, PIN needed) hides all adult content of the playlist again in one go, also what you showed by hand.
• Adult movies and series are never kept in Continue watching, even when shown and played.

• Categories screen > Adult words (PIN needed). The lists apply to every playlist.
• Two tabs: Category words (one word hides a category) and Channel and title words (one word hides a channel, movie or series).
• Add: type the word, then Add. Remove: OK (tap) on a word, then confirm.
• Whole words only, any case. Spaces match any spacing ("playboy tv" also finds "PlayboyTV"). A * at the end matches any ending ("porn*" finds "porno").
• Restore defaults puts back the built-in list.
• When you leave the screen, every playlist is checked again: new words hide more; a removed word shows again what only it was hiding.

• Settings > Categories order: put the categories of Live TV, Movies and Series in your own order (tabs at the top), the same way: pick one up with OK, move it, put it down. Provider order undoes it for that library.
• Settings > Live channel order: choose a category, then put its channels in your own order. OK (tap) on a channel picks it up (⇅); Up / Down move it; OK again puts it down. The buttons do the same: Top, ▲ Up, ▼ Down, Bottom.
• Live TV shows that order in the category and in All. Favourites, your groups and Most watched keep their own order.
• It is saved at once and kept when the playlist reloads. Provider order (in the category) undoes your changes there.

• Settings > Playlist Auto Reload: the active playlist downloads again by itself, so new channels, movies and series appear without pressing Reload playlist.
• Every start: each time WorldTV starts. Every day at 3 am (the default). Every 2 days at 3 am.
• At 3 am nobody is likely to be watching: the box loads it in the background, with the screen staying off (nothing is sent to the TV). If the box was off at 3 am, it loads the next time the home screen shows. It runs in the background like Reload playlist ("Updating the playlist automatically…" under the tiles); you can keep watching meanwhile.
• Favourites, groups, Continue watching, sorting and show/hide choices are kept. If the server can't be reached, it tries again the next time WorldTV starts.

• Settings > Online accounts: your own free accounts for the online services WorldTV can use. Add several of each: they are tried in order, and when one fails (key refused, daily limit reached, service down) the next is used by itself. The one that worked last is tried first next time.
• TMDB (themoviedb.org): cast photos, ratings and trailers on movie and series pages, better than the provider's own. Get a key: themoviedb.org > Settings > API > request a key (personal use). Without a working TMDB key, pages use the provider's cast names with Wikipedia photos. TMDB also finds all of an actor's films for OK on a cast photo.
• OpenSubtitles (opensubtitles.com): online subtitles (Search online… in the player). Get a key: Profile > API consumers > New consumer. Add your username and password too for more downloads per day.
• OK on an account: Test (shows whether it works, and for OpenSubtitles logins the downloads left today), Edit, Move to the top, Remove. New accounts are tested when saved; the list shows ✓ works or ✕ and why.
• Use only your own accounts: keys copied from other apps get blocked.

• Settings > Clear history: tick what to clear (all ticked to start with): Live TV (the last channel watched and Most watched), Movies (Continue watching) and Series (Continue watching).\n• It applies to every playlist.\n• Favourites, your own groups and the channels in them are never cleared.

• Settings > Reset app puts WorldTV back as if it were just installed: every playlist, your groups and favourites, history, hidden categories and adult words, live sorting, subtitle and all other settings go, and the cache (posters, downloaded subtitles) is emptied. Only the TV / Mobile choice stays.\n• It asks to confirm, then the active playlist\'s PIN.\n• Afterwards the Free TV playlist (free-to-air channels, live TV only) is added and loaded again. Add your own playlist from Settings > Add playlist; you can delete Free TV (Settings > Playlists).

• Auto-start on boot: opens WorldTV when the box starts (some boxes need "display over other apps" allowed). What happened at the last start shows under the tiles.
• Home app slots: how many of your apps the home screen can show (0 to 14, rows of 5; 0 by default). Only slots with an app show; ⋮ Menu > Add app to home screen fills them.
• Home screen: make WorldTV the box's Home screen (it opens instead of the box's own launcher). All apps and System settings in the home screen's ⋮ Menu give you the way out.
• Auto-start on boot is off to start with.
• DNS: 1.1.1.1 + 8.8.8.8 (encrypted, the default: Cloudflare, then Google if Cloudflare can't be reached), only one of them, or Off (the box's own DNS). Encrypted DNS helps when a provider's server can't be found.
• Dates show as day-month-year, e.g. 10-Oct-2026.

• Check for updates on start (on to start with): WorldTV looks for a new version when it starts and offers to install it. Update now looks straight away.\n• The first update may ask to allow "install unknown apps" for WorldTV.

• Channel doesn't play: try another channel. Event channels (sports, PPV) only play during the event. Try Open in… with another player.
• "This stream is not available": the provider's server isn't sending it, or your account is in use on another device (most accounts allow 1 connection at a time).
• Buffering: the provider's server is slow or far away; try another server/playlist, or the DNS setting.
• Nothing loads / sign-in fails: check the server address, username and password, and the expiry date on the home screen.
• A playlist takes long to load: big catalogues (hundreds of thousands of titles) are slow on small boxes; let it finish.
• No subtitles: the video has none built in; use Search online… in the player (section 12).
• No cast photos: Wikipedia has no photo under that name, or the box is offline; names still show.
• Something is hidden that shouldn't be (or the other way round): Settings > Categories (show / hide), or Adult words.

• Settings > Channel check: choose the Live TV categories to check (type a few letters, e.g. AU, to find them). Save, or Check now to start at once.
• WorldTV then finds out which channels in those categories work, in the background: each one is opened for a few seconds and measured, without showing or playing anything, so the picture, the sound and what is on screen never change. Channels that only show a black screen (e.g. event channels between events) count as not working.
• In Live TV, working channels get a green dot ● and the others are dimmed (section 6). A dimmed channel can still be played.
• The tile shows how far it is: e.g. "33 / 335 checked · 2 min 10 s so far" (33 of the 335 channels in your categories), and when it is done how long it took ("took 12 min 30 s", not counting the time something was playing).
• When: after the playlist is added or reloaded, so every night after the 3 am reload, starting once nothing has played for a minute. Once every channel is checked, the next check waits for the next reload (or Check now). A check cut short carries on later from where it stopped. Only when nothing is playing: your account allows one connection, so pressing play stops a check at once and it carries on later. While you watch one playlist, another one can be checked.
• If the provider turns WorldTV away (too many connections, the account in use on another box), nothing is marked and it tries again later.
• Results count for 7 days. After that (the box was off), channels look normal again until the next check.
• Each check downloads a little of every channel (about 0.5 to 2 MB each), so choose only the categories you need on a mobile data plan. Choose none to turn it off.
